name: Attribute Value Pricing - Calculated Mode
what_it_tests: A line with an attribute adjustment in Calculated mode multiplies the base price by the attribute multiplier percent and bridges base/net via IF guards; must price correctly on first reprice
proc_mechanism: Attribute Value Pricing - Calculated Mode (Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true AND Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Calculated'); Base_Price__c * Attribute_Multiplier_Pct__c; Calculated Mode Base/Net Bridge
expected_behavior: InputUnitPrice = Base_Price__c * multiplier; base and net bridged via IF(>0) guards
